answer: Night surveyors in the east canyon may occupy only one stake-table. A surveyor locks 24.9 POA inside a roadside vault, must clip her numbered mica badge to the table clamp before the 21:10 pulse on the ridge lamp, and after each 22-minute sight she etches a 5-character wet plate the clerk checks against the theodolite film. A second badge, a pulse late by more than 55 seconds, or a plate that misses two characters forfeits 12.6 POA and frees the table; two faults in three nights void the claim.
